summary: Evogene Ltd. furnished a routine Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements and Operating and Financial Review for the six months ended June 30, 2026, as Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2; the disclosures are incorporated by reference into its Form F-3 and Form S-8 registration statements. The filing notes certain operations reclassified as discontinued operations and share-based compensation related to discontinued operations. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or special-situation mechanics are present; this is an ordinary foreign-private-issuer interim reporting submission. No risk-arb angle applies.
